attempts.progress: All memories recovered; reached extraction; last observed uplink 56% at 01:01 before death.
All memories recovered and extraction completed. Last gameplay capture showed 72% uplink, 94 health, 0 shield.

ratingStatus: Provisional personal judgments from exactly two ordinary attempts, not perfection certification.

strengths.observation: Rain, reflective yard, cyan architectural lines and the large heart relay create a cohesive, attractive station identity. Menu and terminal screens have clear typographic hierarchy.
Opening optic aim produced a critical warden elimination in both attempts; explicit critical feedback made the weak point understandable.
Three named memories, visible objective state, distance markers and lit return aisles gave the short mission a clear arc. Faster second route felt learnable.
Extraction produced real pressure: the first attempt failed after recovering everything, while the second survived after moving back into the baffle area and sidestepping.

issues.observation: Receiver approach was fiddly. I repeatedly saw MOVE CLOSER / STEP INSIDE THE FLOOR RING around 3 to 4 metres while visually beside the pylon or receiver. Direction corrections eventually worked, but focus shifted from combat to positioning. Segmented input amplified this.

Cover blocked several attempted forward routes; apparent progress toward a marker stalled against dumpster geometry and required a lateral detour. Readable as cover afterward, less clear from the initial approach.
Distant small orange enemies and muted threat chevrons were harder to interpret amid signs, objective markers and rain. Late extraction fire direction was easier to notice than exact attackers.

The victorious route needed only the opening elimination; most defenders could be bypassed through running and supply-restoring recoveries. This supports route play but left limited demonstrated shooter depth and makes AAA readiness a low rating.
Station geometry, props and robot silhouettes remain fairly simple and repetitive despite the strong lighting and interface styling.

method.driver: Existing tools/visible-playtest.mjs only; help read before launch; npm run playtest:visible -- --out docs/media/build36-review2

limitations: Screenshot-driven segmented input with Escape pauses limits claims about continuous aiming, moment-to-moment enjoyment and normal real-time difficulty.
No audio enjoyment assessment or hardware performance/FPS claim. Software-WebGL fallback does not establish actual renderer or hardware speed.
Dash used during first return but no successful phase evade or charge break observed; no basis to rate mastery of that mechanic.
Only this one mission and two routes attempted; no settings or recovered-memory reading coverage.
Aim errors, wasted rounds and navigation mistakes retained in the raw action record.
